title: Periodic Labour Force Survey
subtitle: Employment, wages and worker characteristics by NIC industry, occupation and state
_keys: PLFS is a household survey: the unit is a person, not a factory or a shipment. It carries industry (NIC) and occupation (NCO) of work, so it bridges to trade only through the same HS-NIC concordance ASI uses, and only in aggregate. Person-level microdata is never published to the dashboard; only the aggregates declared below are.
_aggregation: PLFS ships as person-level blocks with survey weights. Weighted estimation happens once, in the dataset's own processing step, and only the estimates land in the snapshot. Anything that reads a PLFS row without applying the multiplier is wrong, so the raw blocks are deliberately not exposed to the frontend at all.

panels.title: Employment in related industries
panels.note: Survey estimates, weighted. Mapped from NIC industries, so a product's figure spans every industry the concordance links to it.
